# cloudflare_zone_tracing_rules (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

- `rules` (Attributes List) Trace rules in evaluation order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `zone_id` (String) Specify the zone ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Specify the zone ID.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) Available values: "set_trace_settings".
- `action_parameters` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--action_parameters))
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `expression` (String) A Rules language expression that selects requests.

### Nested Schema for `rules.action_parameters`
